headline: North Georgia ends Montevallo's unbeaten run
dek: Montevallo fell at home to North Georgia, the same opponent that beat it in September, closing its campaign with eighteen wins, two draws and three losses. Lee is the only other side to defeat a program that scored 78 goals while conceding 22.
displaced_by: Montevallo lost to North Georgia, ending its unbeaten run since September

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring is concentrated at the top: Montevallo alone has more goals than UAH, Spring Hill, AUM, Christian Brothers and West Alabama together.

wire.line: Montevallo finishes the season with 78 goals and three losses after falling to North Georgia at home.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Both matches still past their date with no result are Christian Brothers' matches from August.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lainey Farabaugh has scored sixteen goals from 107 shots for Montevallo.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Leslie Azouer has made 104 saves for AUM, at a save percentage of .846.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lee has conceded nine goals across all its matches.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: At least seventeen different players have scored for Lee this season.

last_match.line: North Georgia had already beaten Montevallo in September; this defeat ended Montevallo's unbeaten run since Lee.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
